# Mothman Equinox Event: All Rewards & Guide

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Current Mottenmann dates:**

![](https://nukaknights.com/uploads/event_0_mothman-equinox-skywalka55-fallout76-20230503-20-15-17.jpg) Launch in 27 days 7 hours

##### Event: Mothman Equinox

*Tip: Like this event to receive a notification when it starts or someone comments.*

The Mothman Equinox event was activated for the first time with patch 32 (December 8th, 2021). We at Nuka Knights already reported on this during the PTS. The enlightened ones (Mothman cultists) meet once on the hour in **Point Pleasant** to pay homage to the Mothman with a spiritual ritual.

## Process

**Step 1:**

The event starts on the roof of the Mottenmann Museum by speaking to Interpreter Clarence. Your task, together with other wasteland residents, is to help the enlightened ones carry out the ritual.

**Step 2:**

There are 3 fire pits (water/bridge/church). Clear the 3 fires from the vines. So shoot or cut off the vines there.

**Step 3:**

Defend the 3 fires. Destroy the 10 totems on the roofs. Collect 15 Albino Deer Blood and place it in the sacrificial trough. Kill the 5 Cultist Prophets.

**Step 4:**

When at least 1 more fire has been successfully protected (optimally all 3 fires should not have been destroyed yet), return to the roof of the Mottenmann Museum and do 30 emotes. Then the Mothman arrives and the event ends.

**Tips:**

If you "click" on the Mothman, like in the lighthouse event, you will receive the "Wisdom of the Mothman" for 60 minutes. In this case: **+15% XP Bonus**

The books in the church are gradually unlocked depending on the number of events completed:

1st book: 1 event
2nd book: 3 events
3rd book: 6 events
4th book: 10 events
5th book: 15 events
6th book: 21 events

## Surprise option: Mutated packages

This time the event has a **new background option** that allows Bethesda to activate an additional reward on the server side. As we have already observed at other events. This time there are **Mutated Packs** and if at least 3 Fallout 1st subscribers are in the event **Mutated Party Packs**.

As soon as there is an announcement or players report about the mutated packages, this information will be added here.

![Mutierte Events / Mutated Events: All rewards from Mutant (Party) Packages](/uploads//tn_nukaknights_article_teaser_de_104.jpg) 

### Mutated Events: All rewards from Mutated (Party) packages
